I stopped before editing, because the Design Kit doesn't cover one thing this change needs. The project rules say a gap in the kit means I ask you to extend it, not make something up.

**What the kit has (`design-kit/`):**
- `components/card.html`: one card (white surface, 8px radius, 16px padding, light shadow).
- `components/button.html`: the primary button.
- `tokens.css`: colors, radius, two spacing values (`--space-2` = 8px, `--space-4` = 16px), and the font.

**What's missing:** a rule for the vertical space between two stacked cards. Right now the page (`index.html`) has a single card, so the question never came up. If I add the "Upcoming events" card with no spacing, its edge touches the "Your bookings" card. If I add spacing, I'm choosing a value the kit never defined. The 16px token exists, but the kit doesn't say it applies between cards.

**My recommendation:** add a layout rule to the kit, such as "stacked cards are separated by `--space-4` (16px)". It reuses an existing token, matches the card's own padding, and gives every future card on the page a defined spacing. The cost is one kit update on your side before I can continue. I won't edit `design-kit/` myself, because `tokens.css` says it's a vendored export that gets replaced as a whole.

**Smaller point, to confirm in the same kit update:** the kit has no heading style. The existing card uses an `<h1>` with the browser's default look. I'd copy that for "Upcoming events" so both cards look the same, unless the kit should define a heading for cards.

Once the kit has the spacing rule, I'll make the change on a new branch (not `main`). I'll also need the Linear issue ID for this work, because commit messages must include it.
